title: POST /api/ai/explain: structured AI reasoning for one feature result (owner: Claude A)
description: Request {feature, title, inputs, outputs, figures:[{label,value,unit,basis}], compare:{label,current,recommended,unit}, actions:[string|{text,material_no,qty,unit,date,value_idr}], page}. Feature ids: iplan, golden, fgold, mtime, mnotif, mplan, mrel, ssim, scr, cimp, ccalc, csave, cbuy, sup, links, status, summary, partcard, timeline, page:<tab>. Every number in a Gemini reply must be in the request or the rules draft, otherwise the rules reply is returned. Never throws to the page: offline, the box says so. text = the blocks joined, for logs and the assistant.

verdict.description: one line, the decision in plain words

why.description: each item one number and its basis

risk.description: main uncertainty (backtest error, band width, lead-time spread, unpriced parts) and what would change the verdict

inputs.description: only when the user moved an input off its default
